When & Where

Date October 24, 2026 Saturday
Time 6:00 PM Cocktails · Program to follow
Venue Patio De Cecilia Events Place Sitio Langhaya, Antipolo, 1870 Rizal, Philippines

NO PLUS ONE / NO COMPANION / NO PETS This invitation is for the named guest only — no plus one, even if it's a baby or household member. Pets are also not allowed at the venue. This helps us keep the celebration intimate and comfortable for the debutante. Thank you for understanding!

How to Reach Patio De Cecilia Events Place

1

From Marcos Highway

Coming from Cogeo Gate 2 or Padilla, head toward the Marcos Highway intersection near St. Anthony of Padua Parish Church.

2

Turn onto National Housing Authority Ave.

Turn from Marcos Highway onto National Housing Authority Ave. — you'll pass Neupetro Gas Station along the way.

3

Arrival

Patio De Cecilia Events Place is along National Housing Authority Ave., near Infant Jesus Academy. Look for the gray concrete gate.
